name: 600 EX square-taper bottom bracket
weight_description: Weight not yet sourced for the complete BB-6210 square-taper bottom bracket. The April 1982 catalogue identifies a 119 mm spindle but does not give a separate bottom-bracket weight; no crankset or assembly weight is divided or subtracted.

technical_document.title: Shimano FC-6200 exploded view: associated bottom-bracket cups, bearings and 116/119 mm spindle assemblies

sources.title: Shimano FC-6200 exploded view: associated bottom-bracket cups, bearings and 116/119 mm spindle assemblies
Original Shimano Bicycle System Components catalogue, April 1982, PDF page 57 / printed page 54: FC-6200 with BB-6200 116 mm and BB-6210 119 mm spindle options; no separate weight
Original Shimano Bicycle System Components 1981, PDF page 51: BB-6210 explicitly listed with Deore double cranksets, 119 mm spindle
